title: NLO – Flocculant Dosing Pump Stoppage Alarm

fields.latestPosition: Clarification requested from PTS; PTS to review and confirm (14/08).
fields.nextAction: Check in CITECT whether the alarms exist; if so, close out as implemented (form signed and accepted by PCS engineer 25/01/24).
fields.statusConflict: The signed PDF filed as PCSCR-247 carries form number 241 – the change appears to have been renumbered 241→247; form fully signed at Level 1 (07/01/24) and accepted by the control system engineer with test/backup ticked (25/01/24), but the register still shows In Development after ~1,000 days; form priority 3 – Within 1 Fortnight vs register 2 – Next Week
fields.why: A fault stopped the NLO flotation tailings thickener flocculant pump and it was not picked up, leading to poor thickener performance and poor process water quality.
fields.design:
- Add a CITECT alarm for each flocculant dosing pump: 810-ZM-2295E, 810-ZM-2295F, 810-ZM-2295G
- Trigger a RED alarm naming the pump when it stops while the HPGR is still running (can link to HPGR power) or while the CV-0250 weightometer 140-WIT-0255 reads zero for 1 hour
- PLCs: PLC2, PLC4 and SCADA
fields.impact: CROs get a red alarm identifying which flocculant dosing pump has stopped while the plant is running.
